# STRANGER — Earth System Intelligence & Trend Detection

STRANGER is an interactive environmental trend-detection platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

The platform helps users explore historical Earth-system observations by selecting geographical locations and environmental variables. It transforms environmental data into visual time-series representations and statistical trend insights.

Using the configured NASA Earth data source, STRANGER aims to make environmental trend analysis more accessible through an intuitive interface and statistical techniques such as the Mann–Kendall test and Theil–Sen slope estimation, where implemented.

The project demonstrates how Earth observation data can be transformed into understandable information that encourages environmental awareness and data-driven investigation.

**Technology:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chart.js, Python, Flask.

**Live application:** https://stranger-earth-trend-detective.onrender.com/

**GitHub:** https://github.com/nivedh77/nasaspaceappchallenge

**Team:** STRANGERS

**Team member:** NIVEDH M

Project description

STRANGER is an interactive environmental trend-detection platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It allows users to explore historical Earth-system observations by selecting geographical locations, time periods, and environmental variables.

The platform visualises environmental data through interactive charts and presents statistical trend measures, including the Mann–Kendall test and Theil–Sen slope estimation. It aims to make environmental data easier to understand and help users investigate long-term patterns and changes in Earth's systems.
